devAbout.title: About Us
devAbout.subtitle: DEV is the part of Two Steps Studio focused on building software, tools, and technology. It's where we develop ideas, experiment, and turn concepts into working projects.
devAbout.whatWeBuildP1: We don't limit ourselves to one type of project. We build software, tools, and systems that let us bring our own ideas to life and solve concrete problems.
devAbout.whatWeBuildP2: We care about the whole process - from concept and first prototype, through development and testing, to the finished product.
devAbout.howWeWorkP1: We take a practical approach to building things. We start with an idea, test its potential, build a first version, and gradually develop it further.
devAbout.howWeWorkP2: We're not afraid to experiment. If something doesn't work, we look for a better solution. When a new technology comes along, we check whether it can genuinely improve the project.
devAbout.approachP1: We create to test new ideas. We build to turn them into reality. We draw inspiration from what already exists while searching for our own path.

devRecruitmentPage.title: Join Two Steps Studio
devRecruitmentPage.subtitle: We're looking for people who want to create, experiment, and develop their own ideas together with us. You don't need to know everything - what matters more is a willingness to learn, commitment, and readiness to work on real projects.
devRecruitmentPage.introText: Answer a few questions below and tell us a bit about yourself and your skills.

devPage.title: DEV
devPage.subtitle: We create technologies, tools, and experiences that help turn ideas into working projects. From the first prototype to the finished product - we build, test, and develop the solutions behind Two Steps Studio.
devPage.mainP1: DEV is the space within Two Steps Studio dedicated to building technology and software. We combine programming, systems design, and a creative approach to problem-solving.
devPage.mainP2: We work on our own projects, tools, and solutions that let us realize new ideas faster. It's not just about writing code - we care about building things with a clear purpose that can keep being developed further.
devPage.featureBuildDesc: We build our own projects from scratch, experimenting with technologies and solutions tailored to a specific problem.
devPage.featureExperimentDesc: We test new ideas, technologies, and approaches before deciding which of them are worth developing further.
devPage.featureImproveDesc: Every project is a chance to learn, improve our processes, and build better and better solutions.

devTools.title: Tools
devTools.subtitle: Tools for the Two Steps Studio community - players, musicians, graphic designers and developers. Everything runs in your browser - nothing you enter here is sent to any server.
devTools.timestampDesc: Pick a date and paste the code into a message - Discord shows it in each reader's own time zone.
devTools.snowflakeDesc: Paste a user, message, server or channel ID to see exactly when it was created.
devTools.snowflakeInvalid: That doesn't look like a Discord ID (17-20 digits).
devTools.jwtDesc: Inspect a token's header and payload. The signature is not verified.
devTools.base64Desc: Encode and decode Base64 - UTF-8 safe, accepts URL-safe input too.
devTools.urlDesc: Percent-encode or decode text for use in links and query strings.
devTools.hashDesc: SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 using the browser's built-in Web Crypto API.
devTools.uuidDesc: Random UUIDs from the browser's cryptographically secure generator.
devTools.loremDesc: Placeholder text for mockups and layouts.
devTools.colorDesc: Convert between HEX, RGB and HSL and check WCAG contrast against white and black text.
devTools.aspectDesc: Get the ratio of a resolution, or scale a ratio to your target size.
devTools.tzDesc: Planning a game night with friends abroad? See what time it is for everyone.
devTools.textDesc: Count characters and words, check the Discord message limit and change letter case.
devTools.diceDesc: Fair rolls from the browser's secure random generator - for tabletop games, giveaways or settling arguments.
devTools.pickerDesc: Draw a winner or split players into fair random teams - one name per line.
devTools.timerDesc: Stopwatch with laps, or a countdown that beeps when time is up.
devTools.paletteDesc: Color harmonies and a 50-950 shade scale from one base color. Click a swatch to copy it.
devTools.paletteHint: Copy the scale as CSS variables
devTools.contrastDesc: WCAG 2 contrast between any text and background color.
devTools.contrastSample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
devTools.imageDesc: Convert to WebP, JPEG or PNG and resize. The file is processed in your browser and never uploaded.
devTools.imageDrop: Click or drop an image here
devTools.tapDesc: Tap along to the beat (click, touch or Space) to measure the BPM.
devTools.delayDesc: Note lengths in milliseconds for tempo-synced delays, reverb pre-delay and LFOs
devTools.metronomeDesc: Sample-accurate click with an accented first beat.
devTools.tunerDesc: Tune a guitar, bass, voice or any instrument with your microphone. Audio stays on your device.
devTools.tunerDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser to use the tuner.
devTools.tunerUnsupported: This browser can't access the microphone.
devTools.scaleDesc: Notes of any scale and the chords that fit it. Press play to hear it.
devTools.sensDesc: Keep the same aim when switching games - converts sensitivity and shows cm/360 and eDPI.
devTools.sensNote: Assumes raw input, no mouse acceleration and a 1:1 hipfire (unscoped) sensitivity.
devTools.fpsDesc: How many milliseconds each frame gets at a given frame rate or refresh rate.
devTools.tunerReload: Reload this page once to enable the microphone for the tuner.
devTools.analyzerDesc: Drop a track or sample to estimate its tempo and key and measure its loudness for streaming services. The file is analyzed in your browser and never uploaded.
devTools.analyzerDrop: Click or drop an audio file (MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC...)
devTools.analyzerError: This file couldn't be decoded as audio.
devTools.analyzerTooShort: Couldn't find a clear beat or key - the file may be too short or too quiet.
devTools.analyzerNote: Estimates from the middle 90 seconds. Half or double tempo is common for very slow or fast tracks, and relative keys (e.g. A minor / C major) can be confused - check by ear.
devTools.loudnessPeakWarn: True peak above -1 dBTP: it may clip after MP3/AAC/Ogg encoding. Leave about 1 dB of headroom.
devTools.loudnessSilent: The file is silent - no loudness to measure.
devTools.loudnessNote: Measured per ITU-R BS.1770 / EBU R128 over the whole track. A negative value means the service turns the track down, so a louder master gains nothing and only loses dynamics. A positive value means the track is quieter than the target, and not every service turns it up.
devTools.easingDesc: Shape a cubic-bezier by dragging the handles, preview the motion and copy it for CSS, Framer Motion, Unity or Godot.
devTools.imagePixelArtHint: Scales by whole multiples, pixel-perfect - for sprites and tilesets. Saves as PNG, since lossy compression would smear the edges.
devTools.embedDesc: Build an announcement with a live preview and copy the JSON for a webhook or the code for a bot (discord.js).
devTools.embedSample: **New event** this Friday! Sign up in #events.
devTools.embedNote: The preview renders basic formatting (bold, italics, code, links) - Discord may display the message slightly differently.
devTools.embedFieldEmpty: A field needs both a name and a value
devTools.qrDesc: A QR code for a poster, slide or booth - a link, text or Wi-Fi login. Download as SVG (sharp at any print size) or PNG.
devTools.qrEccHint: L 7% · M 15% · Q 25% · H 30% - higher levels survive dirt or a logo on top, at the cost of a denser code.
devTools.qrTooLong: Too much data for one QR code.
devTools.qrContrastWarn: Low contrast or light modules on a dark background - some scanners may fail to read it. Dark on light is the safest.
devTools.tooLong: Too much text for this tool.
devTools.dropDesc: How likely an item is to finally drop - and how many tries it really takes.
devTools.dropInvalid: Enter the chance as a fraction (1/500) or a percent (0.2%).
devTools.dropAtLeastOnce: Chance of at least one drop
devTools.dropNote: Assumes independent tries with no pity system. A 1/100 chance over 100 tries is only about 63%, not 100%.
devTools.barsDesc: How long a loop or section lasts, and how many bars fit a given time
devTools.noteDesc: Type a note (A4, C#3, Eb2) or a frequency in Hz - with MIDI number, period and wavelength for acoustics and mixing.
devTools.noteInvalid: Not a recognized note or frequency (8-20000 Hz).
devTools.imgPaletteDesc: Pulls the dominant colors out of a photo, cover art or screenshot. Click a color to copy it.
devTools.faviconDesc: From one image: favicon.ico (16/32/48 px), a 180 px Apple icon and 192/512 px PWA icons - plus the HTML to paste.
devTools.faviconCrop: The image isn't square - it will be center-cropped.
devTools.regexDesc: Try a pattern against sample text - with highlighting and capture groups (JavaScript syntax).
devTools.diffDesc: Shows which lines were added and removed - e.g. between two versions of a config or changelog.
devTools.baseDesc: DEC, HEX, BIN and OCT for integers of any size - Discord IDs and permission masks included. Understands 0x, 0b, 0o prefixes.
devTools.caseDesc: camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more - for variable, file and URL names. Accents are converted to ASCII.
devTools.permDesc: Tick permissions or paste an integer to get the value and a ready bot invite link (OAuth2).
devTools.permAdminWarn: Administrator grants every permission and bypasses channel overrides. Give bots only what they need instead.
devTools.permClientInvalid: The application ID is the 17-20 digit number from the Developer Portal.
devTools.permNote: Permission list as in discord.js v14 (discord-api-types 0.38). Names are in English, as in the Developer Portal and the API.

gamesAbout.title: About Games
gamesAbout.subtitle: We create games that combine our ideas, technology, and passion for interactive entertainment. From the first prototype to a finished game - every project starts with an idea.
gamesAbout.ourGamesDesc: Games are one of the main ways Two Steps Studio brings creative ideas to life. We experiment with different genres, mechanics, and styles, creating projects that let us develop both our skills and our own universes.
gamesAbout.prototypeP1: Every project starts with a simple question: "What if...?"
gamesAbout.prototypeP2: Then we build a prototype, test the mechanics, and develop the ideas with the greatest potential. The process can change depending on the project - sometimes it leads to a small game, and sometimes to a much bigger production.
gamesAbout.gameplayFirstDesc: A good game should above all be fun. We design mechanics and systems with the player's experience in mind.
gamesAbout.experimentingDesc: We don't want to keep making the same thing. We test new ideas and look for our own ways of approaching familiar genres.
gamesAbout.growthDesc: Every project gives us new experience. What we learn during one game, we apply to the next ones.
gamesAbout.ctaDesc: See the games we're working on and check out what we're currently creating.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy - Two Steps Studio
privacyPage.s1P1: Welcome to Two Steps Studio ("TSS", "we", "us", or "our").
privacyPage.s1P2: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect information when you use our websites, games, applications, Discord community, and other services provided by Two Steps Studio.
privacyPage.s1P3: By using our services, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
privacyPage.s2Intro: Depending on how you use our services, we may collect:
privacyPage.s2Provided2: Email address (if you contact us or create an account)
privacyPage.s2Provided3: Messages or feedback sent to us
privacyPage.s2Provided4: Information provided during recruitment or community activities
privacyPage.s2Outro: We do not intentionally collect sensitive personal information unless required for a specific service and with appropriate notice.
privacyPage.s3Intro: We may use collected information to:
privacyPage.s3Item1: Provide and improve our games and services
privacyPage.s3Item5: Understand how users interact with our products
privacyPage.s4Intro: Our services may use third-party platforms, including:
privacyPage.s4Outro: These services may collect information according to their own privacy policies.
privacyPage.s5P1: We take reasonable measures to protect user information from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
privacyPage.s5P2: However, no online service can guarantee complete security.
privacyPage.s6P1: Our services are not specifically designed for children under the age required by applicable laws.
privacyPage.s6P2: If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child without appropriate permission, we will take steps to remove it.
privacyPage.s7Intro: Depending on your location, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including:
privacyPage.s7Outro: To request these actions, contact us through our official communication channels.
privacyPage.s8P1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
privacyPage.s8P2: Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated date.
privacyPage.s9P1: For privacy-related questions, contact Two Steps Studio through our official website or community channels.

regulaminBody.heading: TWO STEPS STUDIO REGULATIONS
regulaminBody.s1Item1: These Regulations define the rules for using the Two Steps Studio website and official Discord server.
regulaminBody.s1Item2: By using the website or Discord server, you accept the rules below.
regulaminBody.s1Item3: The administration has the right to update these Regulations at any time.
regulaminBody.s1Item4: Not knowing these Regulations does not exempt you from following them.
regulaminBody.s2Item2: Attempting unauthorized access to accounts, the admin panel, databases, or other Two Steps Studio resources is prohibited.
regulaminBody.s2Item3: Spamming forms, comments, messages, and Two Steps Studio systems is prohibited.
regulaminBody.s2Item4: The user is responsible for the security of their account and login credentials.
regulaminBody.s2Item5: Impersonating the administration, creators, or other users is prohibited.
regulaminBody.s2Item6: Technical bugs must be reported to the administration - they may not be exploited for personal gain.
regulaminBody.s2Item7Intro: Publishing content containing the following is prohibited:
regulaminBody.s3Item2: Insulting, offending, harassing, and provoking are prohibited.
regulaminBody.s3Item3: Spam, flooding, excessive pinging, and emoji abuse are prohibited.
regulaminBody.s3Item4: Advertising other servers, websites, or projects without the administration's consent is prohibited.
regulaminBody.s3Item5: NSFW, violent, or inappropriate content is prohibited.
regulaminBody.s3Item6: Sharing your own or other people's private data is prohibited.
regulaminBody.s3Item7: Using cheats, exploits, and bots to unfairly obtain rewards, levels, or server currency is prohibited.
regulaminBody.s3Item8: Circumventing penalties using multiple accounts is prohibited.
regulaminBody.s3Item9: Voice channels require good conduct - no loud noises, trolling, or disrupting others.
regulaminBody.s3Item10: The administration has the right to delete messages, mute, or ban users who violate these Regulations.
regulaminBody.s4Item1: Points, levels, achievements, and Two Steps Studio currency are entertainment features.
regulaminBody.s4Item2: Exploiting system bugs to gain an advantage is prohibited.
regulaminBody.s4Item3: The administration may reset levels, balance, or achievements in cases of abuse.
regulaminBody.s4Item4: Purchased digital items, ranks, and add-ons are tied to the user's account.
regulaminBody.s4Item5: Attempted payment fraud results in a permanent ban.
regulaminBody.s5Intro: The type of penalty depends on the severity of the violation:
regulaminBody.s6Item1: The administration has the final say in disputed matters.
regulaminBody.s6Item2: The administration may remove content harmful to the community or the project.
regulaminBody.s6Item3: In exceptional situations, the administration may make decisions outside these Regulations for the good of Two Steps Studio.
regulaminBody.s7P1: For appeals, bug reports, or questions, contact the Two Steps Studio administration through the available contact channels on the server.
